purpose: Move a source-free non-bounding torus H2 flux into boundary Wilson data by cutting one periodic direction.

cutMap.description: identify cylinder x=2 boundary with x=0 to recover the 2x2 periodic torus

fluxTransfer.conclusion: The non-exact torus face flux becomes exact on the cut cylinder. Its period is the difference of Wilson circulations on the two new boundary circles.

sourceFreeInterpretation.embedding: Treat the 2-torus as an xy cross-section of the periodic three-torus from Bridge 02 and the face cochain as constant B_z.
sourceFreeInterpretation.gauss: The corresponding three-dimensional face field has d2 B=0 exactly and the xy two-cycle is non-bounding, so nonzero flux requires no magnetic charge.
sourceFreeInterpretation.contrast: Unlike the punctured-sphere example, this is a source-free global flux sector.

verdict: A source-free non-bounding H2 flux obeys the same topology receipt: cutting the torus converts bulk flux into the relative Wilson circulation of the two new boundaries, without invoking magnetic charge or losing the global record.
